title: Spoolman Spool Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spoolman:spool
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(filament_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Spoolman spool events land each day and how many distinct filament values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Spoolman spool records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct filament values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly how much Spoolman spool activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
